sentences.en: But once we left, I went back home, and I have been home ever since.
sentences.tc: 但我們離開之後，我回到家，而且從那之後我一直待在家。

englishTokens.text: But once we left, I went back home, and I have been home

sentences.en: I am planning my trip to Brazil next week, and I am very excited to start traveling again.
sentences.tc: 我正在計畫下週去巴西的旅行，也很興奮能再次開始旅行。

englishTokens.text: I am planning my trip to Brazil next week, and I am very excited to start traveling again.

sentences.en: Where was your first trip?
sentences.tc: 你的第一次旅行是去哪裡？

sentences.en: What made it special?
sentences.tc: 是什麼讓它很特別？

sentences.en: Have a lovely day.
sentences.tc: 祝你有美好的一天。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening.
sentences.tc: 謝謝你的收聽。

sentences.en: Turn on notifications to receive all of my new videos, and like this video for more content.
sentences.tc: 開啟通知來接收我所有的新影片，也請按讚這支影片以觀看更多內容。

englishTokens.text: to receive all of my new videos, and like this video for more

sentences.en: See you.
sentences.tc: 再見。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.tc: 拜拜。

items.meaning: 極好的，令人難以置信的

examples.en: Hello, __welcome back__ to my slow English podcast.
I __took my flight__ to Tulum.
I __had a great time__.

phrases.meaning: 讓某人覺得自己能或想做某事

examples.en: It was the trip that __made me feel like__ I could do anything.
examples.tc: 讓某人覺得自己能或想做某事

examples.en: I saw the most beautiful sunset I have ever seen __to this day__.
I also worked at 《reception》 __from time to time__.
After my trip to Costa Rica, I __couldn't wait__.
I had always wanted to travel to Thailand __ever since__ I was a little girl.
I have been home __ever since__.
I had __made up my mind__.
The moment I __stepped off__ the plane, I began to feel nervous excitement.
I was a little bit lost, so I __asked for directions__.
He __gave me a ride__ to my **hostel**.

phrases.meaning: 在多個地方之間旅行經過

examples.en: I spent three months __traveling through__ Thailand, Cambodia, and Vietnam.
examples.tc: 在多個地方之間旅行經過

examples.en: I __headed out__ to travel again.
The **hostel** was __right next to__ the beach.
I decided I would __go in__ every single day.
It is the city of turtles, and __guess what__ I was going to do there?
We __looked after__ the mama turtles and the baby turtles.
We __took care of__ the mama turtles and the baby turtles.
They need to __lay their eggs__.
It was totally __worth it__.
My ex-boyfriend didn't __get along with__ one of the other **volunteers**.
We were __kicked out__ of the turtle **sanctuary**.
__Turn on__ **notifications** to receive all of my new videos.

usages.usage: 青年旅館或飯店的櫃檯服務區
examples: I also worked at 《reception》 __from time to time__.

usages.usage: 口語中表示很棒、有趣、令人喜歡
examples: It felt strange but also really 《cool》.
I had a fever, 《a cold》, and a cough.

usages.usage: 讓動物誤判方向或訊號

breakdowns.sentence: The first time I ever traveled alone was when I was 18 years old.
breakdowns.translation: 我第一次一個人旅行是在我 18 歲的時候。

points.label: The first time + 子句 / when 名詞子句
points.text: The first time + S + V + was when + S + V
points.note: 用來說明某件事第一次發生的時間

breakdowns.sentence: It was a trip I will remember my whole life.
breakdowns.translation: 那是一趟我一輩子都會記得的旅行。

points.label: 關係代名詞未寫出
points.note: trip 是 remember 的受詞，所以 that 可以不寫

breakdowns.sentence: After making lots of friends, I started planning my next trip.
breakdowns.translation: 交了很多朋友之後，我開始計畫下一趟旅行。

points.label: after + V-ing
points.text: After + 動名詞片語, S + V
points.note: after 後面接動名詞，表示做完某事之後

breakdowns.sentence: I saw the most beautiful sunset I have ever seen to this day.
breakdowns.translation: 我看到至今為止看過最美的日落。

points.label: 最高級 + 現在完成
points.text: the most beautiful + 名詞 + S + have ever + p.p.
points.note: 用現在完成強調到目前為止的經驗

breakdowns.sentence: While I was volunteering in Costa Rica, I saw the most beautiful beaches.
breakdowns.translation: 在哥斯大黎加做志工時，我看到了最美的海灘。

points.label: while + 過去進行式
points.text: While + S + was/were + V-ing, S + V-ed
points.note: 表示某段正在進行的背景時間

breakdowns.sentence: One of my friends is actually the girl who tattooed me.
breakdowns.translation: 其中一位朋友其實就是幫我刺青的女孩。

points.label: who 關係子句
points.note: who 補充說明前面的 girl 是哪一位

breakdowns.sentence: My other friend, whom I met in Costa Rica, introduced me to scuba diving.
breakdowns.translation: 另一位我在哥斯大黎加認識的朋友向我介紹了水肺潛水。

points.label: whom 非限定關係子句
points.note: whom 指前面的 friend，作 met 的受詞，補充額外資訊

breakdowns.sentence: I had always wanted to travel to Thailand ever since I was a little girl.
breakdowns.translation: 從我還是小女孩時，我就一直想去泰國旅行。

points.label: 過去完成式
points.note: 從更早的過去開始，一直到某個過去時間前都存在的願望

breakdowns.sentence: I have always loved Thailand.
breakdowns.translation: 我一直很喜歡泰國。

points.label: 現在完成式
points.note: 表示從過去到現在一直持續的喜好

breakdowns.sentence: Is there any place you have always wanted to visit?
breakdowns.translation: 有沒有哪個地方是你一直想去拜訪的？

points.label: any + 關係子句未寫出 that
points.text: any place + (that) + S + have wanted to visit
points.note: place 是 visit 的受詞，that 可以不寫

breakdowns.sentence: I decided to go two days before my birthday.
breakdowns.translation: 我決定在生日的前兩天出發。

points.label: decide + to V
points.note: decide 後面常接不定詞表示決定要做的事

breakdowns.sentence: The moment I stepped off the plane, I began to feel nervous excitement.
breakdowns.translation: 我一走下飛機，就開始感到緊張又興奮。

points.label: the moment 作連接詞
points.text: The moment + S + V, S + V
points.note: the moment 表示一……就……

breakdowns.sentence: Do you know where this hostel is?
breakdowns.translation: 你知道這間青年旅館在哪裡嗎？

points.label: 間接問句
points.text: Do you know + wh- + S + V
points.note: wh- 子句放在 know 後面時，用直述句語序

breakdowns.sentence: Would you ever spend your birthday alone?
breakdowns.translation: 你會願意一個人過生日嗎？

points.label: would 假設問句
points.note: 用 would 詢問假設情況下的意願

breakdowns.sentence: Which country has had the best food you have ever tried?
breakdowns.translation: 你吃過食物最好吃的是哪個國家？

points.label: 現在完成式問句 + 關係子句
points.text: Which country + has + p.p. + 名詞 + (that) + S + have ever + p.p.
points.note: 詢問到目前為止的人生經驗

breakdowns.sentence: I spent three months traveling through Thailand, Cambodia, and Vietnam.
breakdowns.translation: 我花了三個月旅行穿越泰國、柬埔寨和越南。

points.label: spend + 時間 + V-ing
points.note: 表示花多少時間做某事

breakdowns.sentence: I decided I would go in every single day.
breakdowns.translation: 我決定每天都要下水。

points.label: would 表示過去中的未來
points.note: 在過去時間點談之後會做的事

breakdowns.sentence: Even when I was super sick, I had a fever, a cold, and a cough.
breakdowns.translation: 即使我病得很嚴重，發燒、感冒又咳嗽。

points.label: even when 讓步子句
points.text: Even when + S + V, S + V
points.note: 表示即使在某種情況下，主句仍然發生

breakdowns.sentence: We made sure nobody had bright lights on.
breakdowns.translation: 我們確保沒有人開亮燈。

points.label: make sure + 名詞子句
points.note: 表示確認某件事不會發生或確實發生

breakdowns.sentence: The baby turtles can think the lights are the moon.
breakdowns.translation: 小海龜可能會以為燈光是月亮。

points.label: think + 名詞子句
points.note: that 可以不寫，後面接完整子句作 think 的內容

breakdowns.sentence: We were kicked out of the turtle sanctuary.
breakdowns.translation: 我們被趕出了海龜保護區。

points.label: 被動語態
points.note: 主詞是接受動作的人，用被動語態表達被趕走

breakdowns.sentence: I have been home ever since.
breakdowns.translation: 從那之後我一直待在家。

points.label: 現在完成式 + ever since
points.text: S + have/has + been + 狀態 + ever since
points.note: 表示從過去某時開始一直持續到現在

breakdowns.sentence: Turn on notifications to receive all of my new videos.
breakdowns.translation: 開啟通知來接收我所有的新影片。

points.label: 不定詞表目的
points.text: 動詞片語 + to + 原形動詞
points.note: to receive 說明開啟通知的目的
